_about: Public-domain Samuel Zane Batten, Baptist minister and social-gospel writer, for the Word Hoard: The New Citizenship, The Christian State, The Social Task of Christianity, The Moral Meaning of the War, The New World Order, If America Fail, Building a Community, and Why Not Try Christianity? Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
